title: LGIM策略师：韩国市场仍像赌场，但韩元升值10%后还能再涨
speaker: Ben Bennett

segments.en: I think these single stock leverage ETFs are seeing a really, you know, a drop in volume. They've had a more regulations. Do you think it's much more stable now, this market? It is cleaner, more stable, but is it clean and stable? I don't think so.
segments.zh: 我认为这些单股杠杆ETF的交易量确实下降了。监管也更多了。你认为这个市场现在更稳定了吗？确实更干净、更稳定，但真的干净稳定吗？我不这么认为。

segments.en: I think it's still, I wouldn't quite say it's a casino, but at some point back in June it was moving 5%, 10% a day, which is starting to look like playing the roulette wheel. In my perspective, we are neutral, we don't have big positions in the Korean stock market, but what we do like is the Korean one, is the currency.
segments.zh: 我认为它仍然，我不会说它是赌场，但六月时它每天波动5%、10%，开始像玩轮盘赌。从我们的角度看，我们持中性态度，在韩国股市没有大仓位，但我们喜欢韩元。

segments.en: That has rallied about 10% in the last six weeks or so. So it's already moved a decent amount, but I think it could go further, and that's because the earnings that are coming through for these massive companies, Samsung, SK, Hynex, they're now getting repatriated, and they have to be invested back into Korea, and that is, I think, should bolster that currency.
segments.zh: 韩元在过去六周左右上涨了约10%。已经涨了不少，但我认为还能进一步上涨，因为三星、SK海力士等大公司的盈利正在汇回，必须再配置到韩国，这应该会支撑韩元。

segments.en: I didn't really understand why it was so weak earlier in the year, because it's moved. Yeah, exactly, it didn't make any sense. But it's moved now, and I think it could move a little bit further, so I think that's the best way to play Korea.
segments.zh: 我不太理解为什么年初韩元那么弱，因为它已经涨了。是的，完全没道理。但现在涨了，我认为还能再涨一点，所以我认为这是参与韩国市场的最佳方式。
